title: Why Clear Project Documentation Matters
hook: A project without structure becomes hard to resume.
summary: A short fictional educational video about organizing project documentation.

scenes.title: The messy start
scenes.visual_description: A desk with scattered notes and unclear filenames.
scenes.narration: Every project starts with energy, but without structure, the next step becomes harder to find.
scenes.visual_prompt: Fictional desk, scattered notes, soft light, no real data.

scenes.title: The structure appears
scenes.visual_description: Notes become organized into folders and README sections.
scenes.narration: A simple structure can turn scattered progress into something reusable.
scenes.visual_prompt: Fictional folders and clean documentation layout.

scenes.title: The reusable package
scenes.visual_description: A clean package card with title, hook, scenes, caption, and metadata.
scenes.narration: A ScriptPackage is an intermediate layer between idea and output.
scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract package card, futuristic interface, no private content.

caption: Clear documentation helps a project become resumable, reusable, and safer to share.
public_boundary: This is a fictional sanitized example. It does not contain private prompts, real exports, or personal data.
